study.question: Does widening only the click residual adapter from16 to64 hidden units reduce the signed-versus-even coarse-summary readout gap, after matching capacity and execution at each width? The broader question remains whether supplied event order has useful predictive information in the strongest joint model at justified measured cost.
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: g1-r0073 signed_bridge=0.6684190188831848 AUC, even_readout=0.6665827901831676 and axis_bridge=0.6667055157905444. The signed-even gap0.0018362287000172 survives replacing the discontinuous pivot axis with continuous sign averaging, but a16-unit shared ReLU adapter may be a bottleneck for conditional even functions. Increasing only that adapter to64 units may preferentially improve the even treatment. Mechanism hypothesis is conditional capacity/optimization limitation, not a presumed winning model. If the gap persists at64 against a same-width signed control, this particular finite-width explanation weakens while forward polarity utility remains provisional. All outcomes are unmeasured for the new variants.

nearest_work.difference: Exact inherited even readout averages f(x,c) and f(x,-c) before the unchanged click tower/Dice. We vary only click-adapter hidden width in a2x2 readout-by-width study; the16-unit bridge recovers this implementation.
Retain signed treatment as a same-width capacity control at16 and64; all unselected sign/axis paths still execute with algebraic zero coefficients.

Archived primary text lines250-282 supports target-dependent unnormalized local activation and reports a sequence-model attempt in its own setting. Inherit the local field/four-task adaptation, not its external efficacy claims. This proposal isolates a downstream signed-summary adapter capacity effect, not a new attention architecture or exact DIN reproduction.

Pinned benchmark forward lines113-159 pools target-attended history and tokenizes fields/tasks. This proposal retains the existing compressed history and modifies only one task adapter, without adopting hierarchical token interaction. Original-author equivalence is unverified.

Pinned benchmark forward lines175-200 flattens item/history embeddings with context before tokenization and mixing. No flattened history tokenizer or UniMixing block is introduced. This is a controlled local capacity diagnostic; no novelty/priority claim is made.

study.proposed_difference: A literal primary_residual_hidden architecture option with values16 or64 replaces ONLY the is_click residual_bank Linear/ReLU/Linear after all inherited learned modules are initialized. Both widths first construct the original16-unit bank. Width64 replaces the click module in a separate CPU RNG fork, zeros its final layer as inherited and discards the old click module from registration. Thus every nonclick parameter, running buffer and caller RNG is preserved across widths at initialization. Four standalone modules implement even64(candidate), signed64(control), even16(control), signed16(control). No input event is reordered, no current action or label enters forward, and no training-loss hook changes. All nonconstructor model methods are AST-identical to g1-r0073-signed_bridge. Full-model/gradient parity remains a host prerequisite.
predictions: Let S16,E16,S64,E64 be validation click AUCs. Primary estimates are G16=S16-E16, G64=S64-E64 and D=(E64-E16)-(S64-S16)=G16-G64. Report every absolute score/difference and measured costs, even when decision thresholds are not met.

First require16-unit signed/even bridges to recover their r0073 trajectories under the same host interface. A practical AUC discrepancy beyond0.00005 requires diagnosis before interpreting D; native prediction/gradient parity should be tested directly at shared nonzero weights rather than relying only on AUC or zero-output initialization.

Predeclared capacity-support pattern: E64-E16>=0.0005, D>=0.0005, and S64>=S16-0.0002. This would provisionally implicate finite adapter capacity/optimization; a gap reduction caused only by signed-control degradation is not support.

If E64 is within0.0002 AUC of S64 or better AND the capacity-support pattern holds, the16-unit deficit does not establish necessity of polarity at this consumer. The other inherited order paths prevent a broader invariance conclusion.

If reliable bridges and S64-E64>=0.0005 while G64>=0.8*G16, the signed advantage survives this fourfold hidden-width replacement at matched capacity. This weakens the tested width bottleneck explanation, without claiming capacity sufficiency or a general order mechanism.

At each width signed/even have the same registered parameters and three adapter calls. Across widths only click parameters grow by48*(adapter_input_width+value_width+1), with the output bias unchanged; embeddings remain31793216 and narrow total/dense remain32192421/399205. Measure actual total/dense counts, allocated GPU seconds, wall time, memory, throughput and latency instead of inferring equal realized cost.
History-length slices are preexisting exploratory diagnostics, especially17-64 and>64 where r0073 gaps were larger. They are not independent confirmatory tests or an added selection objective.
falsifiers: No preferential even improvement, or a larger G64, contradicts the specific prediction that widening this adapter alleviates its observed deficit; it does not refute every capacity/optimization explanation.

A smaller gap driven by signed degradation fails the capacity-support rule. Equal improvements with a persistent gap are a generic capacity benefit, not evidence for the proposed differential bottleneck.

Invariance failure for E(x,c)=E(x,-c) at common nonzero weights, altered nonclick initialization or RNG, mask leakage, changed buffer populations or failed bridge parity invalidates attribution; fix/re-propose while retaining all charges.

Any quality gain whose measured cost is dominated by a lower-cost signed or unchanged utility reference does not establish an efficiency improvement. No equal-compute conclusion follows from a fixed-data-pass comparison.

Zero output-layer initialization delays first-layer learning; more random hidden features can improve one-pass optimization differently in each treatment. Widening is a mechanism contrast but not an independent initialization repetition.

The prior r0063-66 multi-view averaging changed populations/execution and showed negative trajectories; this study inherits r0073 single-adapter averaging and cannot interpret those failures as universal order evidence.
